utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case IT-08-91-A, the Prosecutor versus Mico Stanisic and Stojan Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Before I commence, I would like to make sure that all parties hear the proceedings in a language they understand. Mr. Zupljanin?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT ZUPLJANIN
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I hear you very well. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Appearances by the parties. Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. PINZAUTI
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Giulia Pinzauti appearing for the Prosecution, together with Mr. Aditya Menon and Ms. Indah Susanti, our case manager. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Pinzauti. For the Defence for Mr. Stanisic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. My name is Slobodan Zecevic. I'm lead counsel appearing on behalf of Mr. Stanisic. Together with me are our colleagues, legal assistants, Mr. Coman Kenny and Mr. James Jackson. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. The Defence counsel for Mr. Zupljanin, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. CMERIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. President. Tatjana Cmeric appearing today on behalf of Mr. Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Cmeric. I note that Mr. Stanisic is not present in the courtroom. As I know you know, he has waived his right to be present and is therefore represented today by his counsel. This Status Conference is called in accordance with Rule 65 bis of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. Rule 65 bis (B) requires a Status Conference to be convened within 120 days after the filing of a Notice of Appeal and, thereafter, within 120 days after the last Status Conference, to allow any person in custody pending appeal the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto, including the mental and physical condition of that person. In the present case, parties filed their Notices of Appeal on 13 May 2013. Today's Status Conference is the first in this case and was scheduled by a Scheduling Order issued on 10 July 2013. I turn to detention conditions and health of Mr. Stanisic and would like to inquire into the status of the detention condition and health conditions of Mr. Stanisic. If Mr. Stanisic has any concerns in relation to the detention conditions or his state of health, I would invite Mr. Zecevic to raise them now. If you wish, this discussion can, of course, take place in a private meeting.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: No, Your Honour. I don't think there is any need for a private meeting because Mr. Stanisic has no issues to raise at this point.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. I'm happy to hear that he has no problems, either with detention or with health conditions. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Turning now to Mr. Zupljanin, I would like to inquire into the status of the detention conditions and health situations of Mr. Zupljanin. If you have any concerns in relation to the detention conditions on your state of health, I would invite you to raise them now. If you wish, this discussion can, of course, take place in private session. Mr. Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT ZUPLJANIN
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. President. I really have nothing to be proud of. Also, it wouldn't be of much use to complain. I will let everything be as God wills and I wish to thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Zupljanin. A few words on the recent procedural history. Before I ask the parties whether there are any additional issues or any issues they would like to raise, may I recount briefly part of the recent procedural history of this case. On 16 April 2013, the parties were granted an extension of time of 15 days to file their Notices of Appeal. On 13 May 2013, all of the parties filed their respective Notices of Appeal. The Prosecution presented two grounds of appeal, Stanisic formulated 15 grounds of appeal, and Zupljanin filed four grounds of appeal. The appellants' briefs were filed on 19 August 2013, with the view to have the briefing of these appeals completed on 16 October 2013. On 2 July 2013, Stanisic filed two motions: One motion seeking admission of additional evidence pursuant to Rule 115 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence and one motion seeking leave to amend his Notice of Appeal. On 23 July 2013, I assigned Judge Carmel Agius to consider both motions. On 24 July 2013, Judge Carmel Agius assigned Judge William Hussein Sekule to replace me on the Bench for the purpose of considering these two motions. That composition of the Appeals Chamber will render their decisions on these two motions in due course. On 9 July 2013, Zupljanin sought leave to correct three typographical errors in his Notice of Appeal. The Appeals Chamber granted the request on 19 August 2013. On 12 August 2013, Zupljanin requested leave to amend his Notice of Appeal. The Appeals Chamber will render a decision in due course. At this point, I would like to ask the parties whether they have any other issues that they would like to raise. And let me start with Ms. Pinzauti for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. PINZAUTI
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. We have nothing to raise at this stage.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you so much.

utterances.speaker: MS. PINZAUTI
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Counsel for Mr. Stanisic, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Your Honours, we have nothing to raise at this point; however, I would seek a clarification with Your Honour. On page 4, line 3, it says that the briefing -- the view -- "with the view to have the briefing of these appeals completed on 16 October 2013." However, Your Honour's decision granted us the period until -- of 11th of November to file the response and the reply in these proceedings.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you for drawing my attention to that. We will look into the matter and clarify it as soon as we can. And again thank you very much, too, for drawing my attention to it.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Counsel for Mr. Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: MS. CMERIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Nothing on behalf of Mr. Zupljanin at this point either.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you so much. So I believe that this concludes today's Status Conference, and I thank the parties for their attendance. And I would call these proceedings to a close.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: adjourned at 3.10 p.m.
